name: Completion Contract
description: Run an acceptance-driven autonomous development pass; repair errors, verify every relevant screen and interaction, checkpoint and hand off until independently verified.
prompt: Use installed Synapse skill completion-contract as the default discipline for this development task, together with autonomous-dev-loop and existing Quality OS / browser-ui-audit / Repair Arena. Load full SKILL.md and project AI context; check concurrent writers and existing checkpoints before any edits. Define and execute a verifiable acceptance checklist, continue bounded work batches with durable checkpoints and recovery, test real desktop/mobile interactions and the backend, protect user data and unrelated work, and do not claim verified_complete until all required evidence and quality gates pass. Escalate only truly necessary user authorization, secrets, payment or potentially destructive actions; do not bypass authentication. At each model/tool boundary save exact next step for daemon supervisor to resume. Report test evidence and residual limitations faithfully.
